provenance.note: Polygon-interior City core segments (four Douro St rows excluded by the A1 street exception) plus four reviewed adjacent frontage corridors whose IDs equal the City intersection-ID path between their anchors, plus reviewed Exhibition Place internal road rows. A record matches when its road equals the row or corridor road and each named cross road is an intersection on a constituent City row. Lake Shore Blvd W ends at British Columbia Rd because named Dufferin St does not meet Lake Shore in Centreline. Unlisted segments fail closed.
